links.outcome: CDSS versus human TDM expert on error detection and target attainment in silico
links.effect: Sensitivity 53% vs 45%, specificity 83% vs 100%; target attainment 55% vs 37% (P=.046); 4 detrimental interventions in CDSS arm vs none for expert.
links.quote: The CDSS matched the expert in error detection, with numerically higher sensitivity (53% versus 45%) but lower specificity (83% versus 100%), and it achieved higher therapeutic target attainment (55% versus 37%; P=.046).

screen.reason: Evaluates Tucuxi-CDSS, a model-informed precision dosing tool featuring automated error detection workflows and data safeguards, validated in silico against expert dosing decisions.

primary.practice: automated data validation and pre-analytical error checking
